items.title: Coca-Cola tops earnings estimates, hikes full-year outlook as demand for drinks climbs
items.description: Coca-Cola said demand for its drinks rose in every market in the second quarter, helped in part by the World Cup.

items.title: Boeing posts wider loss than expected as Air Force One costs weigh on results
items.description: Boeing took a $280 million charge on its long-delayed Air Force One program.

items.title: UPS beats earnings expectations, raises full-year guidance
items.description: UPS beat Wall Street expectations and raised its full-year guidance in its second-quarter earnings report Tuesday.

items.title: Iran hosts Hormuz calls with Saudi Arabia, Oman as Trump hails ‘good talks’
items.description: Talks over the Strait of Hormuz continue as Iran's foreign ministry discussed the strategically vital maritime passage with Saudi and Omani counterparts.

items.title: Trump says U.S. has sold more than $13 billion of Venezuela oil since Maduro's capture
items.description: President Donald Trump said Monday the U.S. has sold more than $13 billion of Venezuelan oil since taking control of the South American nation's energy exports.

items.title: Apple plans to lease iPhones for $17.99 a month through partnership with Klarna
items.description: Apple is announcing an iPhone lease option weeks after raising iPad and Mac prices due to the global memory shortage.

items.title: Lawmakers renew push to axe a lucrative tax loophole for crypto investors
items.description: Crypto investors have largely been exempt from the "wash sale" rules that apply to stocks and other traditional assets. Congress is trying to clamp down.

items.title: Amazon, Meta and Microsoft face skeptical investors this week after Google report sparked sell-off
items.description: Alphabet's free cash flow has turned negative, and the company lifted its capital spending forecast. Slower-growing cloud rivals report this week.

items.title: Blurred front lines: Trump to meet Zelenskyy as Ukraine, Iran wars collide
items.description: Trump and Zelenskyy's meeting comes as the U.S war against Iran and Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine have threatened to overlap in recent days.

items.title: SpaceX has now lost the equivalent of a full Tesla in market capitalization
items.description: Elon Musk's space company has wiped off more than $1.2 trillion in market cap since hitting a high of $225.64 per share in June.

items.title: Analysis: Kevin Warsh's Fed press conference will be revealing even without a rate hike
items.description: Warsh will reveal how he weighs energy shocks, AI-driven price pressure, the Fed's task forces and pressure from Trump.

items.title: New Republican ads slam Democrats opposed to Trump's tariffs
items.description: As the 2026 midterm elections approach, the National Republican Congressional Committee is knocking Democrats who have opposed President Donald Trump's tariffs.

items.title: SpaceX stock-purchasing by Congress members fuels conflict concerns
items.description: Five of the Congress members serve on committees whose work touches SpaceX's federal contracts, defense programs, AI, telecommunications or securities markets.

items.title: Wildfires burn nearly 300,000 acres in France and Spain as heat wave looms
items.description: Temperatures in France are expected to rise to 95 degrees Fahrenheit this week, as firefighters battle the ongoing wildfire, which has affected parts of Spain.

items.title: China’s reported chip breakthrough comes with some big caveats
items.description: China is reportedly producing a key chip tool in a market dominated by ASML. But analysts questioned China's ability to compete with the Dutch giant.

items.title: Micron, Nvidia fall after SK Hynix plunges nearly 15% as chip sell-off deepens
items.description: Semiconductor stocks fell in premarket trading on Tuesday, extending a rout in chipmakers after another weak session on Wall Street.

items.title: Supreme Court approval hits record low as Republicans' support declines
items.description: The Trump administration saw some big losses at the Supreme Court in 2026 on issues involving tariffs, birthright citizenship and the Federal Reserve.

items.title: U.S. and Korean tech stocks are now tightly linked — and that could be a worry for investors
items.description: The 60-day correlation between the Kospi and Nasdaq 100 recently climbed to about 0.50, its highest level since 2021, according to data provided by Rayliant.

items.title: Microsoft touts cost-saving AI model for cybersecurity
items.description: Microsoft says that when integrated with OpenAI's GPT-5.4, its new cybersecurity model can beat Anthropic's new Mythos 5.

items.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says AI company isn't advocating for ban of open-weight models
items.description: Critics have questioned why Anthropic didn't sign an industry letter last week in support of open-weight models.
